# UI/UX Pro Max

UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile interfaces.

## Applicable Scenarios

Use this skill when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

## Supported Stacks

React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, and HTML/CSS.

## Coverage

- 50+ design styles
- 161 color palettes
- 57 font pairings
- 161 product types
- 99 UX guidelines
- 25 chart types

## For This Project

The frontend (`src/web`) is Angular 21 with PrimeNG (`primeng`, `@primeuix/themes`, `primeicons`) and Tailwind-compatible styling, SignalR for realtime updates, and vitest for UI tests. Apply the skill when:

- Creating or modifying Angular components/routes
- Adjusting color schemes, typography, or layout
- Reviewing accessibility (contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA)
- Designing charts or data visualizations for results grids
- Building governance UI (`/governance` route) and report intake chat

## Process

1. Understand the user intent and requirements before any creative work
2. Propose 2-3 design approaches with trade-offs
3. Present the design and get approval before implementing
4. Implement following existing project conventions (Angular + PrimeNG patterns)
5. Review against UX guidelines and accessibility standards
